newsitem.title: USA: Isolyser sees Q3 loss w/ charges, modest Q4 profit.
newsitem.headline: Isolyser sees Q3 loss w/ charges, modest Q4 profit.

text.p: Isolyser Co Inc said Tuesday that it expects to report a third quarter net loss of about $0.15 to $0.17 per share, which it attributed primarily to nonrecurring charges related to its August 30 merger with Microtek Medical Inc.

The company said it "estimates a break-even third quarter," excluding $3.2 million in merger expenses and excluding a one-time charge of about $3 million for consolidating manufacturing and administrative functions and services and adjusting inventory.
The company said however that its integration with Microtek is proceeding on schedule, and it projects a "modest fourth quarter profit."
The company said it is confident the merger will produce growth, and it expects to be "comfortably in the black in 1997."
